items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Sunday after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles. Speculation on possible snap limits.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury report; Schefter expected to play; Levitan notes great to have back, possible limits.
items.implication: WR1/2 upgrade if full; monitor snaps.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets potential vs PHI secondary without key pieces.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN after hamstring; full participant, good to go vs Cowboys. Excellent DvP spot.
items.why: ETR report; Rapoport/Texans PR good to go; Levitan: Cowboys inflate WR scoring 7.3%, Texans high implied points.
items.opportunity: High target share return in favorable matchup.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT for Sunday; listed among players out.
items.why: Schefter outs list; ETR OUT; Rapoport aligned previously.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/carries to backup (e.g. Allen if available).

items.text: DeVonta Smith ruled OUT vs Rams due to hamstring; missed practice all week. Eagles also without Goedert and Baun.
items.why: Schefter; ETR OUT; Levitan: Eagles situation worse without three key players; Berry reacted with sigh.
items.implication: Eagles pass game downgraded; Hurts/others impacted.
items.opportunity: Targets to remaining WRs/TEs like Wicks or others; reverse if unexpected IN.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT Sunday due to sprained ankle; did not practice.
items.why: Schefter breaking; Vikings report; Rapoport corroborates; ETR lists OUT.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Addison and others.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (foot) LP-DNP-LP; already cracked rib this season. Q tag; projecting in with docks.
items.why: Practice: LP-DNP-LP; ETR Q; prior rib.
items.implication: Game-time; risk of limited or OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT, targets to other LAC WRs.

items.text: Jordan Addison opportunity with Jefferson OUT: home vs borderline secondary. Moment truthers waiting for.
items.why: Jefferson OUT creates vacuum; matchup favorable.
items.implication: WR2/3 smash potential; start over typical.

items.text: Mike Evans (ribs) game-time decision per Shanahan; intends to play through with padding. ETR Q; Rapoport notes painful but plans to go.
items.why: Coach comment; player intends; Rapoport corroborate.
items.implication: Monitor; if OUT boost to Kittle/others.
items.opportunity: If IN limited; if OUT TE/WR volume up.

items.text: Jadarian Price tough start: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass downs to Holani, fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet practicing. Eye test positive long-term but OUT this week; projections updated.
items.why: Usage data: role erosion + injury; Charbonnet back at practice; ETR OUT both.
items.implication: Avoid short-term; hold long-term if rostered.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins 13.8% target share (pace 64 catches) with Sampson out virtually all season; was 8.3% when Sampson healthy. Usage up significantly.
items.why: Target share data with teammate absence; 4-game sample but clear increase.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out. CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Usage: 90% snaps/workhorse; Dowdle out again; matchup.

items.text: LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches (more than W1+2 combined), RB5 utilization, double-digit target share every game. NYG allows 5.1 YPC.
items.why: Explosive usage jump; matchup vs Giants.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton: RB27 utilization, 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps to 42%, 13% third-down. SEA allows 2.9 YPC.
items.why: Low usage/role; tough run D matchup.

items.text: LOVE Drake London: 35% target share/104 ypg career with Penix; 43.5% last week (9-194). NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Penix chemistry; high target share; matchup.
